title: Add binary file analysis - metadata capture, display, and editing for images/videos/documents
acceptance_criteria: New 'Binary Analysis' tab/view in the navigation
Image metadata display: EXIF, IPTC, XMP (camera model, GPS, date, etc.)
Image metadata editing: modify or strip EXIF data
Video metadata display: container format, codec, duration, resolution
Document metadata: PDF properties, author, creator tool
Format conversion: image re-encode between formats (JPEG, PNG, WebP)
Binary hex viewer for raw file inspection
Uses research findings from task 08 for library selection
